## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND and HYG (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION signal rising risk, while SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND and Stocks vs Bonds (↑ rising) provide offsetting risk-on pressure.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear INCREASING: VXX (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising). Credit stress rising: Credit spread level 0.7337 (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD show strain; reflation signals from CPER/GLD (↑ rising) support commodity strength.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: Dollar (Level 26.85) RECOVERY (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -0.67%) and TLT (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND with the yield curve (↓ falling) flattening, keeping conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials breadth positive (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +8.69%); Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND. Style: Cyclicals/value showing relative strength over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US steady: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND while QQQ (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION. EM/China showing improvement: EEM (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +2.43%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative demand waning: ARKK (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -4.70%) BELOW TREND; IWM (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.68%) CORRECTION shows mixed small-cap interest.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity reflation intact: UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +15.53%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND. Gold taking profit: GLD (1W: -2.85% | 1M: +11.55%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas surge notable via UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (7/11) and XLE/SOXX both ABOVE TREND provide durable cyclical signals. DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (URA, XME, GLD) constitute MINOR divergences to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +13.57%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to speculative/theme ETFs (ARKK (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND, IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -4.70%) BELOW TREND); bonds neutral but watch TLT (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +13.57%) ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, ARKK (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND, IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -4.70%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +15.53%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PPLT (1W: -22.68% | 1M: -1.80%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -18.80% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION warrant caution.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~27.5 (rising/increased fear), Credit spread / HYG-LQD ~0.73 (stress marker), XLK/XLF ratio 2.6924 (tech vs financials pivot), Breadth 7/11 (watch for break below 7).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive with mixed risk signals (VXX up, credit stress rising versus SPY and cyclicals strong). Cyclicals/energy (XLE, BNO, UNG) showing strength while tech and thematic ETFs (XLK, ARKK, IBIT) are showing weakness — monitor commodity-driven reflation and 1W/1M divergences.
